title: DRHP Reader
audience: IPO and QIP analysts, anchor investors and diligence teams
description: Reads an offer document (DRHP, RHP, letter of offer or placement document) filed with the exchanges or uploaded to a Project: what the money is for, who is selling, the stated risks, outstanding litigation, related-party dealings and the plans the company commits to.

args.empty: No statement of the issue's objects in the offer documents on record.

sections.title: Who is selling: promoter group and other shareholders

args.empty: No promoter or selling-shareholder detail in the offer documents on record.
No risk-factor passage in the offer documents on record.
No litigation or related-party passage in the offer documents on record.
No dated plans in the offer documents on record.
